player_prompt.intro: Ị bụ onye na-egwu egwuregwu {player_id} na egwuregwu nke Reverse Tic Tac Toe. Ihe akara gị bụ '{symbol}'. Ihe mgbaru ọsọ bụ izere ịnweta atọ n'usoro (na-agagharị agagharị, n'ụzọ kwụ ọtọ, ma ọ bụ diagonal). Ọ bụrụ na ị na-eme atọ n'usoro, ị na-atụfu. Nyefee usoro gị site na iji usoro '[4]' iji tinye akara gị na cell 4. Dị ka onye na-egwu egwuregwu {player_id}, ị bụ '{symbol}' na onye iro gị bụ '{opponent_symbol}'.

game_action.placed: Onye ọkpụkpọ {player_id} tinyere akara ha ({symbol}) na cell {cell}.

outcome.loss: Onye na-egwu egwu {player_id} na-efunahụ site na imecha ahịrị!
